bounded_search.scope_note: Queries search PR text/title, not every source file on every branch. The exact known base filename check and explicit semantic-source comparison supplement them. No exhaustive novelty guarantee or uniqueness of mathematical ideas follows.

existing_exact_interfaces.origin: PR590 public prerequisite as pinned by both interfaces

comparison.finding: XOR cancellation, preservation of an unmodified source and sequential composition are existing algebraic ingredients. PR590 supplies a generic Boolean register interpreter; PR612/878 bind selected B words and derive helper/target translation properties. The new package should not claim to invent those algebraic facts.

The retained generic BitXor.single addresses arbitrary logical registers in State=Reg→Bool; sourcesRun and run compose gate/operand lists. Neither compared B package defines a tape-head traversal, marker alphabet, finite machine control or first-halt transition count. The new paired primitive moves through an arbitrary finite word with finite phases/one scratch bit; the marked successor reads explicit L/R cells and removes the earlier boundary-observation primitive.

The first machine proves exact 5*n+2 first halt in its boundary-observing zipper model, in-place target XOR, unchanged source, returned head/clean scratch and cell conservation. The explicit seven-symbol successor proves 5*n+4 first halt and n+2 represented cells at every prefix, including n=0, with real entry/rewind/marker steps. Its output relation reuses the first machine and core Nat XOR specification.

The two accepted sources are byte-distinct from both compared phase interpreters and the exact PR590 prerequisite. They import only official Init modules and each other; no selected literal data or PR612/878 module is duplicated. Structural induction and standard Bool/Nat XOR APIs are common techniques, not claimed new.

The bounded marked/tape text query also surfaced earlier count, compact-copy, parameter and parking publications. Their titles/bodies demonstrate prior explicit tape implementations, so do not claim the first tape formalization. They were not reopened or replayed; this narrow assessment does not duplicate their full source audits.

recommended_scope_sentence: This package implements reusable finite paired-bit XOR scans with explicit local transition semantics, exact first-halt counts and tape-footprint proofs. Earlier PR590/612/878 supply ordered Boolean-register semantics and selected-word interfaces; those arithmetic identities and the broader tape-model literature are prior work. The result supplies a concrete bit-word implementation layer, without an optimality claim or selected physical-program refinement.
publication_limits: Distinguish 5n+2 boundary-observing semantics from 5n+4 explicit-marker semantics. Neither number is a practical runtime measurement or a universal cost in every machine model.
Input paired layout, marker installation, initialization/reset and any different instruction-model simulation must be supplied and charged by the caller.
Scratch is explicitly initialized false; the arbitrary target/source data are supported, but arbitrary dirty scratch/history and signed/exponent alignment are separate.
The marked implementation is an end-to-end output refinement, not an asserted lock-step simulation of every predecessor prefix.
This package does not certify a selected multiplier, change kappa or prove an all-size integer complexity theorem.

existing.imported_core: Lean core List and Nat bitwise APIs, retaining upstream authors/copyright including Lean FRO and Joe Hendrix. Core source/runtime are not copied into the proposed package.

attribution_assessment.recommendation: Keep James Chang/OpenAI and Apache-2.0 plus Lean core List/Nat bitwise attribution. Mention PR590/612/878 as related Boolean semantics if discussing overlap, without implying their selected source is imported or copied. Retain both native terminals and failed preimages in their established provenance.
